KIND:       AdaptiveDialog
SCHEMA:     bot (vendor/skills-for-copilot-studio @ 9c42d3a)

DESCRIPTION:
    A topic: a scripted conversation flow in topics/<Name>.topic.mcs.yml.
    beginDialog holds its trigger and the nodes to run. Under generative
    orchestration it can also declare inputs and outputs, so the orchestrator
    calls it like a function. Its schema name is `<agentSchema>.topic.<Name>`.

    YAML: `kind: AdaptiveDialog`
    See: docs/04-topics-and-triggers.md#anatomy-of-a-topic-file

FIELDS:
  kind	<string> -required-
  beginDialog	<TriggerBase>  # one of 28 kinds
  confirmation	<ResponseTemplateNoKind>
    activity	<ActivityTemplateBase>  # one of 3 kinds
    mode	<TemplateResponseMode | =expr>
  conversionMetadata	<ConversionMetadataNoKind>
    initializedVariableIdToTypeMapping	<map[string]DataType>  # one of 21 kinds
    variableIdToNameMapping	<map[string]string>
  endAutomatically	<boolean | =expr>
  inputType	<RecordNoKind>
    properties	<map[string]PropertyInfoNoKind>  # one of 22 kinds
    sensitivityLevel	<SensitivityLevel>
  inputs	<[]TaskInput>  # one of 2 kinds
  modelDescription	<string>
  modelDisplayName	<string>
  outputType	<RecordNoKind>
    properties	<map[string]PropertyInfoNoKind>  # one of 22 kinds
    sensitivityLevel	<SensitivityLevel>
  recognizer	<Recognizer>  # one of 2 kinds
  response	<ResponseTemplateNoKind>
    activity	<ActivityTemplateBase>  # one of 3 kinds
    mode	<TemplateResponseMode | =expr>
  startBehavior	<TopicStartBehavior>
  triggers	<[]TriggerBase>  # one of 28 kinds
